Onboarding.Title: Getting started
Onboarding.Subtitle: A quick setup path to your first backup.
Onboarding.Step1: Add your projects root and register a project.
Onboarding.Step2: Pick a preset (auto-selected) or choose No preset.
Onboarding.Step3: Run your first snapshot or backup.
Onboarding.Tour.Step1.Title: Set your projects root
Onboarding.Tour.Step1.Body: Choose the folder where your projects live so VaultSync can find them.
Onboarding.Tour.Step2.Title: Add a project
Onboarding.Tour.Step2.Body: Select a project and add it to VaultSync to start tracking snapshots.
Onboarding.Tour.Step3.Title: Pick a preset
Onboarding.Tour.Step3.Body: Use a preset to filter temp files. You can keep the auto-selected one.
Onboarding.Tour.Step4.Title: Run your first backup
Onboarding.Tour.Step4.Body: Start a backup to lock in your first snapshot on your chosen destination.
